page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 7T83 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. The server contains 256.0 GB of total system memory, resulting in a 1:2 ratio of 2.0 GB RAM per virtual core. It provides no local SSD storage, requiring external block storage for persistent data, and is configured with a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without complimentary public IPv4 addresses or hardware acceleration GPUs.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation emphasizes compute core density over large per-core memory footprints, making it tailored for highly multithreaded and parallel processing workloads. Because no local storage is included, disk-heavy operations depend entirely on network-attached storage performance. Qualitatively, the instance delivers efficient resource packing for compute-bound tasks that require high parallel vCPU capacity. Primary workload fits include high-performance compute tasks, batch data processing, distributed software compilation, and scalable application servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized x86_64 server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor clocked at 2.55 GHz, it provides 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of RAM, offering a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 2.0 GB per core. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage and a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth for data throughput. The high core density and dedicated virtual CPU allocation make it suitable for compute-intensive parallel tasks, continuous integration and software compilation pipelines, batch processing jobs, and microservices infrastructure where high processing throughput is prioritized over large memory allocations.
